name: lincx-mcp-server
description: Lincx MCP server — browser login UI, Redis-backed sessions, multi-network support

scripts.predev: docker compose up -d redis || echo '[predev] Could not start Redis (is Docker running?) — continuing; set REDIS_URL= in .env for the in-memory store.'
scripts.predev:local: docker compose up -d redis || echo '[predev:local] Could not start Redis (is Docker running?) — continuing; set REDIS_URL= in .env for the in-memory store.'
